student.deploy_output: original final 128^3 raw segmentation logit only

lomix.coarse_upsampling: explicit final spatial size, trilinear, align_corners=false
lomix.original_heads: new Conv3d aux heads only for 32^3 and 64^3; 128^3 reuses existing network.conv_final Norm-Act-Conv
lomix.attention: for each concrete k-stage subset: Conv3d(k,k,1,bias=true) on concatenated raw logits, softmax dim=1, weighted sum
stable_map_order: then subsets 01,02,12,012 with add,multiply,concat,awf inside each subset
lomix.loss_weight: softplus(alpha), alpha initialized to zero, unconstrained and unnormalized
lomix.total_loss: raw sum over all 19 original and mutant weighted losses; no division by 19 or weight sum
lomix.registered_modules: one Conv3d concat and one attention module per concrete subset
lomix.inference: discard auxiliary heads, fusion modules, and alpha; use original final head

fixed_training.optimizer_parameter_scope: plain deploy model, 2 aux heads, 4 concat Conv3d, 4 attention Conv3d, and 19 alpha in one AdamW group with the same LR and weight decay
fixed_training.gradient_clip: global norm 5.0 over every optimizer parameter
fixed_training.learning_rate: existing frozen late-cosine schedule through global epoch200

matched_control.source: existing archived supervised continuation with identical starting checkpoint, seed, sampler, augmentation, optimizer, and schedule

fixed_validation.selection: maximum LoMix scan Dice among epochs 176/184/192/200; subject Dice exact-tie-break

promotion_gates_all_required: selected LoMix scan and subject Dice strictly beat matched control at the same epoch
selected LoMix scan and subject Dice strictly beat voxel-KD epoch200
selected LoMix point hit is no more than one of 108 cases below voxel-KD epoch200
paired scan and subject bootstrap 95% CI lower bounds versus voxel-KD epoch200 are both at least -0.003
formal checkpoint reload max absolute difference is zero
stripped deploy-only model final logits exactly equal the training wrapper final logits
all implementation and GPU smoke gates pass

technical_stop_gates.missing_gradient: any registered auxiliary, concat, or attention parameter lacks finite nonzero gradient in synthetic/GPU smoke
technical_stop_gates.gpu_memory: batch8 smoke OOM or peak allocated greater than 72 GiB
technical_stop_gates.deploy_mismatch: wrapper final logit differs after stripping auxiliary modules
technical_stop_gates.reload_mismatch: formal final reload maximum absolute difference is nonzero
technical_stop_gates.softplus_collapse: mean softplus(alpha) below 0.173286795 at any saved epoch

if_gates_fail: stop without operation, alpha rule, loss weight, epoch, threshold, checkpoint, or postprocessing search; do not access test270
